primary_msc_basis: arXiv:2305.12582v1 explicitly lists primary MSC2020 46B04; arXiv:1807.03814v1 is older contextual literature with a different primary classification.
scientific_integrity: Analytical all-parameter proof with positive John multipliers, direct matrix-tree determinant, and nonstandard singular asymptotic; corroborating symbolic/numeric computations are not substituted for proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one anomalous two-edge path, with the same positive length on both edges; no arbitrary heterogeneous theta-network classification.
No claim of generic full-edge-contact behavior for all graph metrics.
The exact quadratic and scaling law have not received independent scientific validation; equivalent unindexed literature cannot be excluded.
title: A singular crossover in John ellipsoids of one-path-defect \(K_{2,m}\) metrics
